verdict.rationale: BILL's platform API documents explicit bulk endpoints (POST /v3/payments/bulk for up to 50 bills, POST /v3/payments/mass for up to 2000 bills) and bulk record export, showing genuine multi-item automation support at the API/platform level. However, these bulk endpoints are documented for AP (bills) rather than shown specifically for Spend & Expense transactions/cards, and there's no evidence of bulk expense categorization, bulk card management, or bulk approval actions specific to the S&E product. Missing for 10: dedicated bulk operation endpoints for S&E-specific objects (transactions, cards, expense reports), independent/hands-on confirmation of bulk usage at scale.
